theme_archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy / Calm Finance) - Tailored for Premium Mobile UI

shadows.soft: shadow-color: #0B192C; shadow-offset: {width: 0, height: 4}; shadow-opacity: 0.05; shadow-radius: 12; elevation: 2
shadows.floating: shadow-color: #0B192C; shadow-offset: {width: 0, height: 8}; shadow-opacity: 0.08; shadow-radius: 24; elevation: 4

hero_safe_spend.description: The most important element of the app. Placed at the top of the Home screen.
hero_safe_spend.layout: Centered vertically and horizontally within its container.
hero_safe_spend.label: Puedes gastar hoy
hero_safe_spend.animation: react-native-reanimated for smooth number incrementing on load
hero_safe_spend.status_integration: Background tint of the hero container changes subtly based on status (e.g., safe_green_bg if 'Vas bien').

status_pill.description: Green/Amber/Red indicator pill underneath the main number.
status_pill.text: Vas bien / Cuidado / Riesgo / Mejor espera

primary_button.interaction: Scale down slightly on active press using Reanimated

quick_action_fab_row.description: Row of 4 circular buttons underneath the hero section for quick actions.

can_i_buy_this_simulator.interaction: User inputs price. App calculates impact. Screen turns soft green/amber/coral based on result.
can_i_buy_this_simulator.result_cards: Rounded cards explaining impact on days remaining.

screens.name: Onboarding (3 screens)
screens.layout: Hero image at top (60% height). Title, description, and dots pagination below. Primary button at bottom.

screens.name: Setup Wizard
screens.layout: Step-by-step full screen cards. Progress bar at top. Very clean, avoiding overwhelming forms.

screens.name: Home (Inicio)
screens.layout: Top: Greeting + Avatar. Middle: Massive 'Puedes gastar hoy' number + Status Pill + Cycle progress bar. Bottom: Quick action buttons row. Very bottom: Upcoming payments snippet list. Clean white background.

screens.name: Can I Buy This? (Simulator)
screens.layout: Large numeric keypad, floating input field. Results displayed in a bottom sheet with clear safe/careful/not recommended status.

screens.name: Expenses (Gastos)
screens.layout: List view with categorized grouped dates. Icons mapped to categories (Food, Transport, etc.) with soft colored backgrounds.

screens.name: Calendar (Calendario)
screens.layout: Monthly grid view. Paydays marked with green dots. Bills marked with red/amber dots. Tapping a day shows safe spend for that specific day.

screens.name: Envelopes (Sobres)
screens.layout: Bento grid of rounded cards representing envelopes. Each card has a different pastel background (soft green, soft blue, peach) and progress bar.

screens.name: Premium Paywall
screens.layout: Luxurious feel. Deep Navy background for this specific screen to contrast. 3D geometric hero image. Comparison table (Free, Pro, Plus) with gold/soft blue highlights. Large compelling CTA.

onboarding_1_calm.description: Minimalist 3D abstract illustration of a glowing soft green coin gently floating. Use for Onboarding Screen 1.

onboarding_2_safe.description: Minimalist 3D abstract illustration of a soft blue protective shield. Use for Onboarding Screen 2 or Simulator success.

premium_paywall_hero.description: Premium abstract 3D composition with geometric shapes. Use as header graphic for the Premium Paywall screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JS files for the React Native/Expo app, not TSX. Follow pure functional component patterns.
Use react-native-reanimated for smooth number counting in the Hero component and subtle layout transitions.
Apply `data-testid` attributes to all touchables, buttons, and text inputs using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., `data-testid="home-safe-spend-number"`).
Ensure 'Puedes gastar hoy' number is the largest text element in the app, using the specific scale mapped in typography.
Use `@expo/vector-icons` for category and tab bar icons; avoid native emojis.
Ensure the UI uses high padding (e.g., padding: 24) to maintain the premium, uncluttered aesthetic.
Do not use dark mode globally. Enforce light mode strictly to preserve the white/navy/soft green premium aesthetic.
